scientific_integrity: The universal result is proved analytically from parity, a Sturm--Liouville boundary identity, and Cauchy full rank. The bundled finite computations are explicitly corroborative only. Literature comparisons distinguish the prior low-pass framework and later bandpass construction from the new exact hemisphere multiplicity law.
scientific_limitations: The exact multiplicity at concentration 1/2 and the reflection pairing are proved for scalar spherical harmonics on S^2 and arbitrary finite degree masks; no closed form is claimed for the remaining paired eigenvalues, nor for spin-weighted, vector, or higher-dimensional analogues.
title: Exact half-energy multiplicities for hemispherical spherical Slepian concentration with arbitrary degree masks
